observations: Two industrial machines side by side, both blue and beige, with control panels and mechanical components.

Photo 0 shows a vertical machine with a control panel at the top, a blue base, and a central column with mechanical parts. The right machine has a similar design but with a different control panel and visible wear.
Photo 1 shows the same two machines from a slightly different angle. The left machine has a digital display on the control panel, while the right machine has a manual dial and a warning label.
Both machines appear to be used, with visible dust, grime, and some wear on the surfaces and wheels.
The machines are on a tiled floor, under a roofed structure, with trees and buildings visible in the background.
No readable brand or model names are visible on either machine in either photo.
The seller claims the machine is in 'top working condition' and 'fully automated'.

claims.claim: This machine is in a top working condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show the machines but do not show operation or internal components. No proof of functionality is visible.

claims.claim: The company just invested in a fully automated system.
claims.evidence: No evidence of automation or investment in the photos. The machines appear manual or semi-automated.

claims.claim: Fully working, recently serviced by the dealer, all parts complete. Original from the manufacturer.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Machine may not be fully functional or may have hidden mechanical issues.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine operating, including the control panel, mechanical parts, and any automated features.

risks.risk: The machines may be damaged or have worn-out parts not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the internal components, gears, belts, and electrical connections.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with unknown wear

risks.risk: The machines may not be fully automated as claimed.
risks.proof: Photos or video showing the automation features, such as programmable controls or robotic arms.

proof_requests: Video of the machine operating, showing control panel, mechanical parts, and any automation features.
Close-up photos of internal components, gears, belts, and electrical connections.
Photos of any manuals, labels, or serial numbers on the machines.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
